title: Describe accounting for stock appreciation rights

items.concept: Initial recognition and multi-year subsequent measurement of cash-settled (liability) SARs; period-end adjusting entries; cash settlement at exercise
Number-variant twin: four-year liability SARs schedule including a year with negative compensation expense; settlement
Equity classification when employer controls settlement; straight-line expense without remeasurement; cash settlement with catch-up expense; stock settlement reclassification
ASC 718 classification: employee cash settlement feature → liability; employer stock settlement control → equity
Settlement JE after liability is fully remeasured to expected cash
